questions.title: Is IELTS 6.5 enough for an MS in Canada?
questions.body: I have IELTS 6.5 overall (6.0 in writing). Will top Canadian universities accept this for a master's, or should I retake?
questions.author: Aarav

answers.body: Most Canadian universities accept 6.5 overall with no band below 6.0, so you likely qualify. A few competitive programs want 7.0 — check each program page. Your 6.0 writing is fine for most.
answers.author: Mentor

questions.title: USA vs Germany for an MS in Computer Science on a tight budget?
questions.body: Budget is around $20k/year. Is the US realistic with scholarships, or is Germany a better bet?
questions.author: Neha

answers.body: On $20k, Germany is far safer — public universities are almost tuition-free and living is ~€11.9k/yr. The US is possible only with a big assistantship/scholarship. Run both through the ROI calculator.
answers.author: Mentor
